_README: Template for DISTRESS_JURISDICTIONS_FILE. Every value in caps is a placeholder.
Nothing here is a working endpoint. A Socrata dataset is addressed by an opaque
four-by-four id and its columns are named by whoever published it, so an entry
written from memory is a guess, and a guessed id returns 404 -- which this
pipeline reads as 'no records in this county' rather than as a broken entry.
Fill these from a real portal, or generate them from live catalogs with:
That reads one real row per candidate and writes the column names it observed.
Then prove each entry before trusting it:

jurisdictions._purpose: Recorded transfers. Feeds cash-buyer discovery via POST /cash-buyers/sync/{id}.

_purpose: Mortgages and deeds of trust. Optional, and the only way a purchase is
ever reported as cash: /cash-buyers/sync cross-references this index and
confirms cash only for addresses absent from it.
Scope it with a where filter. The cross-reference is abandoned if this
index is truncated by the row cap, because an address missing from a
partial read is not an address with no mortgage.
jurisdictions.where: OPTIONAL filter scoping this to the same period as the deed feed

jurisdictions._purpose: Non-judicial foreclosure. Check /foreclosure-procedure/states/XX first: judicial states produce lis_pendens instead, and a feed pointed at the wrong office returns nothing.
